about_the_game:
About This Game

Play as the summoned creature, not the hero. In Autumn's Dungeoneering, you are the loyal companion following your AI-controlled adventurer through dangerous dungeons. Your survival depends on reading their commands, supporting their goals, and navigating the complex psychology of being someone else's pet.

The Relationship at the Heart of Everything

Your AI owner gives you direct orders through visual commands - attack this enemy, protect this ally, scout that area. But here's the twist: sometimes disobedience saves lives. A dynamic approval system tracks every choice you make. Follow orders and succeed? Your bond strengthens. Ignore commands or fail? Trust erodes. Let that approval drop too low and face permanent dismissal - game over.

Your AI remembers everything but forgives slowly. Every relationship is a psychological chess match where your survival depends on keeping them happy while making the right strategic calls.

Unique AI Personalities to Master

Saki the Methodical Explorer moves carefully through dungeons, punishing disobedience severely but offering a safe way to learn the relationship mechanics.

Tama the Chaotic Fighter finds violence amusing and throws you around when you disobey, requiring constant adaptation to unpredictable combat decisions.

Each AI adventurer has distinct personality traits, forgiveness rates, and behavioral patterns. Unlock new relationships by maintaining bonds and spending hard-earned mana points.

Choose Your Contract

Shadow Goblin - High-risk assassin with shadow teleportation and instant-kill abilities Water Elemental - Crowd control specialist with freezing attacks and battlefield manipulation
Imp - Support buffer enhancing your owner's combat effectiveness Earthen Elemental - Pure tank drawing enemy fire and providing defensive buffs Anna the Divine Water Spirit - Special relationship with possession abilities and unique story elements

Persistent Progression

Earn mana points from combat kills and end-of-dungeon approval bonuses. Higher approval ratings mean bigger rewards. Even if dismissed, you keep your mana to unlock new adventurers and abilities. Every relationship teaches you something new about the delicate balance between obedience and independence.

Early Access Warning

This game is in very early development. Not all features are implemented yet. When the game enters beta, it will transition to paid access. Jump in now to experience the core relationship mechanics and help shape development.

Remember: You're the pet, not the hero. Your success depends entirely on reading your AI owner's needs, following their lead, and knowing exactly when to disobey for their own good.

short_description: You're the pet, they're the hero. Follow orders, fight monsters, and try not to get fired by your owner. Because nothing says "fantasy adventure" like navigating workplace dynamics with someone who can literally dismiss you.
